svg.title: Two Curves
svg.desc: Interpretive study after an actually inspected primary reference. Geometry and interpretive screen colour approximate. White lens-shaped painted support with two different convex curves meeting at pointed ends. This white work remains separate from the black Two Curves2012 Marks painting; no identity based on title alone. Foundation photograph explicitly labels this title and EK identifier; medium classification remains as sourced. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): source review remains unresolved for white; prior provisional screen colors retained, not calibrated to original paint.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://ellsworthkelly.org/exhibition/ellsworth-kelly-sculpture-on-the-wall/; catalogue record foundation-exhib-v4-ek1046-ellsworth-kelly-sculpture-on-the-wall; inspected2026-10-27. Pure editable vector study, not photographic facsimile.
